items.prompt: Sepia-toned 1970s flashback, faded vintage film grain, cinematic anime film still, semi-realistic painted anime art like a Makoto Shinkai movie. On a 1970s railway platform at night, an elderly Indian man with white hair, round glasses and a leather satchel hands a baby in an embroidered shawl to a railway porter in a red kurta with a brass arm badge, then turns toward the burning train, flames ahead of him.

Cinematic anime film still, semi-realistic painted anime art like a Makoto Shinkai movie, detailed hand-painted lighting, soft depth of field, film grain. Extreme close-up of an old yellowed newspaper: a small grainy black and white photo of a baby in a hospital cot with a short printed caption beneath it, dramatic lamp light.
